column4: Added android can deliver one press of Back by two routes at once (the game's own key handling and the system back-gesture callback, depending on the Android version and how the app was opened).
Routed both Android Back paths through the same guarded game action.
Added a device test covering back Walks Backwards One Step Per Press. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.
Added a device test covering difficulty Is Chosen On The Character Screen And Not In Settings. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.
Updated Android checks and fixtures for statistics screens device. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.
Made the visible exit button follow the screen’s own Back behavior.
Moved the new-run difficulty selector onto hero selection.
Added the difficulty of the run you are about to start, on the character screen where the run is set up: one touch each for 1 to 5, and the level written out ("3 - Normal").
Removed the difficulty selector from APD Settings after moving it to run setup.
Preserved previous-menu navigation when closing statistics dialogs.
Added a test covering the Same Press By Two Routes Counts Once. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.
Added a test covering two Real Presses Are Two Backs. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.
Added a test covering the First Press Is Always Accepted. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.
Added a test covering every Level Has A Name and Three Is Normal. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.
Added a test covering the Explanation Says That A Run Keeps Its Difficulty. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.
Added a test covering normal Is Still The Unmodified Baseline. These are development checks, not a gameplay feature.
Updated engineering handoff accompanying this build.
